prompt: I've been bad about tracking my finances lately and need to catch up. In my workspace there's a file called `raw_transactions.txt` with all my spending from March and April 2026 written out informally. Please enter all of those transactions into the expense tracking system — make sure to preserve the correct dates, categories, tags, and descriptions as listed. Once everything is logged, generate a side-by-side comparison report of the two months (totals and spending by category) and save it as `spending_comparison.json`.
